'''''The Wrath of Darth Maul''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] junior novel written by [[Ryder Windham]]. It was first published in hardcover by [[Scholastic]] on [[January 1]], [[2012]]. It chronicles the origins of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and adapts stories from several other titles, such as "[[Restraint]]," "[[End Game]]," and [[Star Wars Journal: Darth Maul|''Star Wars Episode I Journal: Darth Maul'']].
